recommendations.title: Antonio Inoki vs. Muhammad Ali
recommendations.why: Historically essential context for shoot-style wrestling and the later development of mixed martial arts.

recommendations.title: Bruno Sammartino vs. Superstar Billy Graham
recommendations.why: The title change that ended Sammartino's second reign and reset the WWWF main-event scene.

recommendations.title: Tiger Mask vs. Dynamite Kid
recommendations.why: The first match in a rivalry that helped redefine junior-heavyweight wrestling.

recommendations.title: Starrcade 1983: A Flare for the Gold
recommendations.why: The prototype closed-circuit wrestling supercard and the defining early Crockett event.

recommendations.title: Kerry Von Erich vs. Ric Flair
recommendations.event: David Von Erich Memorial Parade of Champions
recommendations.why: An emotionally charged NWA World title change before a huge Texas Stadium crowd.

recommendations.title: WrestleMania I
recommendations.why: The national expansion's decisive gamble and the beginning of WWE's defining event series.

recommendations.title: Randy Savage vs. Ricky Steamboat
recommendations.why: A landmark meticulously constructed Intercontinental title match.

recommendations.title: Ric Flair vs. Sting
recommendations.why: The 45-minute draw that established Sting as a national main-eventer on free television.

recommendations.title: Ric Flair vs. Ricky Steamboat
recommendations.why: The first televised title match in their celebrated 1989 trilogy.

recommendations.title: Ric Flair vs. Ricky Steamboat — two out of three falls
recommendations.why: A near-hour technical title match presented on free television.

recommendations.title: Ric Flair vs. Ricky Steamboat
recommendations.why: The conclusive match in the 1989 trilogy, followed by the launch of Flair's rivalry with Terry Funk.

recommendations.title: Mitsuharu Misawa vs. Jumbo Tsuruta
recommendations.why: A generational upset that launched Misawa as All Japan's new native ace.

recommendations.title: Sting's Squadron vs. The Dangerous Alliance — WarGames
recommendations.why: Often treated as the definitive WarGames match: violent, coherent and built around months of television.

recommendations.title: Bret Hart vs. British Bulldog
recommendations.why: A stadium main event that pairs atmosphere with a demanding, dramatic performance.

recommendations.title: The 1-2-3 Kid vs. Razor Ramon
recommendations.why: The upset that demonstrated how one weekly-TV match could create a new star and months of story.

recommendations.title: Bret Hart vs. Owen Hart
recommendations.why: An opening match that combines family rivalry, technical precision and a result that drives the entire event.

recommendations.title: Mitsuharu Misawa vs. Toshiaki Kawada
recommendations.why: A central King's Road championship match and a high point of 1990s All Japan.

recommendations.title: When Worlds Collide
recommendations.why: A landmark U.S. PPV presentation of lucha libre, anchored by an extraordinary mask-versus-hair tag match.

recommendations.title: Mitsuharu Misawa & Kenta Kobashi vs. Toshiaki Kawada & Akira Taue
recommendations.why: A dramatic summit of All Japan's tag-team storytelling and the Four Pillars era.

recommendations.title: Austin 3:16
recommendations.why: The tournament victory and post-match promo that supplied the slogan for WWE's coming boom period.

recommendations.title: Mitsuharu Misawa vs. Kenta Kobashi
recommendations.why: A definitive championship match in Kobashi's rise and one of the clearest introductions to King's Road escalation.

recommendations.title: Bret Hart vs. Steve Austin — submission match
recommendations.why: A perfectly executed double turn and one of WWE's most important character transitions.

recommendations.title: Shawn Michaels vs. The Undertaker — Hell in a Cell
recommendations.why: The original Cell match establishes the stipulation, pays off a long chase and introduces Kane.

recommendations.title: Bret Hart vs. Shawn Michaels — Montreal
recommendations.why: Essential viewing because the real-life finish directly reshaped WWE television and the Mr. McMahon character.

recommendations.title: The Undertaker vs. Mankind — Hell in a Cell
recommendations.why: One of wrestling's most replayed spectacles; historically important but unusually dangerous.

recommendations.title: Mitsuharu Misawa vs. Kenta Kobashi
recommendations.why: A masterclass in cumulative rivalry storytelling and heavyweight escalation.

recommendations.title: Mankind wins the WWF Championship
recommendations.why: The signature ratings-war episode: a world-title payoff, a famous spoiler and a decisive audience swing.

recommendations.title: Edge & Christian vs. The Hardy Boyz vs. The Dudley Boyz
recommendations.why: The triangle ladder match that set the template for WWE's early-2000s tag-team spectacle.

recommendations.title: WrestleMania X-Seven
recommendations.why: The culmination of the Attitude Era and one of WWE's strongest complete-event recommendations.

recommendations.title: CM Punk vs. Chris Hero — 93-minute match
recommendations.why: A demanding independent-wrestling time-limit epic that defines their early rivalry.

recommendations.title: Kenta Kobashi vs. Mitsuharu Misawa
recommendations.why: The definitive transition in NOAH's heavyweight hierarchy and the start of Kobashi's celebrated title reign.

recommendations.title: Samoa Joe vs. CM Punk II
recommendations.why: A 60-minute draw that expanded ROH's reach and became a calling card for the 2000s independent scene.

recommendations.title: Kenta Kobashi vs. Kensuke Sasaki
recommendations.why: A famously physical heavyweight match built around endurance and extended strike exchanges.

recommendations.title: AJ Styles vs. Samoa Joe vs. Christopher Daniels
recommendations.why: The signature match of TNA's early X Division and a core company recommendation.

recommendations.title: Samoa Joe vs. Kenta Kobashi
recommendations.why: A dream match presented with exceptional atmosphere and a disciplined heavyweight structure.

recommendations.title: Do Fixer vs. Blood Generation
recommendations.why: A breathtaking six-man showcase that introduced many U.S. viewers to Dragon Gate's house style.

recommendations.title: Bryan Danielson vs. Nigel McGuinness
recommendations.why: A unification match with extraordinary crowd investment and escalating technical violence.

recommendations.title: Naomichi Marufuji vs. KENTA
recommendations.why: A defining junior-heavyweight rivalry elevated into NOAH's GHC heavyweight main event.

recommendations.title: John Cena vs. Shawn Michaels
recommendations.why: A near-hour free-television rematch demonstrating the value of major matches within weekly chronology.

recommendations.title: Ric Flair vs. Shawn Michaels
recommendations.why: A polished career-versus-career match with one of WWE's most memorable emotional finishes.

recommendations.title: The Undertaker vs. Shawn Michaels
recommendations.why: A modern WrestleMania standard built around reversals, near falls and two fully established characters.

recommendations.title: Kevin Steen vs. El Generico — Fight Without Honor
recommendations.why: The emotional conclusion to one of ROH's strongest year-long stories.

recommendations.title: CM Punk vs. John Cena
recommendations.why: A rare collision of real-world contract tension, hometown atmosphere and a decisive WWE title story.

recommendations.title: Kazuchika Okada vs. Hiroshi Tanahashi
recommendations.why: The match that confirms Okada's arrival and establishes New Japan's defining rivalry of the decade.

recommendations.title: Kazuchika Okada vs. Hiroshi Tanahashi
recommendations.why: A superbly paced title match and one of the best entry points into modern New Japan.

recommendations.title: Tomohiro Ishii vs. Katsuyori Shibata
recommendations.why: A compact, ferocious G1 match that became a modern strong-style reference point.

recommendations.title: Shinsuke Nakamura vs. Kota Ibushi
recommendations.why: A charismatic, athletic Intercontinental title match and an ideal gateway to 2010s NJPW.

recommendations.title: Sasha Banks vs. Bayley
recommendations.why: A landmark NXT women's title match with a complete underdog story and lasting influence.

recommendations.title: Shinsuke Nakamura vs. AJ Styles
recommendations.why: A first-time singles meeting between two stars at the end of their NJPW runs.

recommendations.title: Sami Zayn vs. Shinsuke Nakamura
recommendations.why: A farewell and debut match carried by crowd knowledge, simple stakes and exceptional timing.

recommendations.title: The Final Deletion
recommendations.why: A pivotal piece of cinematic wrestling that became one of Impact's most influential weekly-TV experiments.

recommendations.title: Kazuchika Okada vs. Kenny Omega
recommendations.why: The first match in a rivalry that dramatically expanded New Japan's international audience.

recommendations.title: Tyler Bate vs. Pete Dunne
recommendations.why: A compact, high-impact UK title match that immediately defined the belt's early standard.

recommendations.title: WALTER vs. PCO
recommendations.why: A cult spectacle that helped relaunch PCO and captures Spring Break's improbable-match appeal.

recommendations.title: Kazuchika Okada vs. Kenny Omega — two out of three falls
recommendations.why: The long-form conclusion to Okada's record title reign and the central match of their series.

recommendations.title: All In
recommendations.why: The independently produced arena sell-out that directly paved the way for AEW.

recommendations.title: Cody Rhodes vs. Dustin Rhodes
recommendations.why: A deeply personal match that gave AEW's first PPV an emotional centre.

recommendations.title: WALTER vs. Tyler Bate
recommendations.why: A long, patient UK title match built around size, resilience and crowd belief.

recommendations.title: Kenny Omega & Hangman Page vs. The Young Bucks
recommendations.why: A tag-team match rich with layered character history and elite-level escalation.

recommendations.title: WALTER vs. Ilja Dragunov
recommendations.why: An exceptionally physical empty-arena title match whose atmosphere comes entirely from the work.

recommendations.title: Britt Baker vs. Thunder Rosa — Lights Out
recommendations.why: A breakout free-television main event that elevated both wrestlers and AEW's women's division.

recommendations.title: The Young Bucks vs. Lucha Brothers — steel cage
recommendations.why: A spectacular tag title match with a decisive emotional payoff.

recommendations.title: Bryan Danielson vs. Minoru Suzuki
recommendations.why: A major first-time match deliberately released free on YouTube.

recommendations.title: Will Ospreay vs. Michael Oku
recommendations.why: A dramatic British heavyweight title match that established Oku at RevPro's top level.

recommendations.title: CM Punk vs. MJF — dog collar match
recommendations.why: The violent payoff to one of AEW's most carefully developed personal rivalries.

recommendations.title: Will Ospreay vs. Orange Cassidy
recommendations.why: A cross-promotional showcase that turns a stylistic contrast into a compelling title match.

recommendations.title: MJF vs. Bryan Danielson — Iron Man match
recommendations.why: A 60-minute title match that tests MJF's in-ring credibility against an ideal opponent.

recommendations.title: AEW All In London 2023
recommendations.why: Essential for scale and atmosphere: AEW's Wembley Stadium debut and largest live presentation.

recommendations.title: Bryan Danielson vs. Zack Sabre Jr.
recommendations.why: A long-awaited technical showcase built around the question of the world's best technical wrestler.

recommendations.title: Will Ospreay vs. Bryan Danielson
recommendations.why: A first-time dream match staged as a direct contest over in-ring supremacy.

recommendations.title: Swerve Strickland vs. Bryan Danielson
recommendations.why: A career-versus-title Wembley main event with strong character stakes and a definitive finish.
